prompt_record.text: Edit this workflow-create illustration. Change only its extra props: remove the two books, the pencil/brush cup with all its tools, and the vase with all its foliage, leaving uninterrupted plain tabletop in their places. Preserve exactly the central blank ivory standing frame, its perspective, the small four-pointed amber star and warm light, paper grain, calm graphite/ivory/desaturated palette, background, canvas composition and empty bottom third. No new objects, no text or UI. This is a minimal editorial spot illustration.
